fusions.name: Cinder Cough
fusions.desc: Coughs up a cinder from your own throat that hits the first enemy for 7 fire damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Furnace Breath
fusions.desc: Howls flame through a cone 4 tiles ahead for 26 fire damage that ignores resistances. It grows 8% stronger for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Hackles Alight
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and sets them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Ember Whelp
fusions.desc: A bonded whelp of fire follows you and bites enemies within 4 tiles for 4 fire damage every 1.3 seconds, setting each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
